display.purpose: Brand wordmark on standalone pages (login, register, player splashes).

h2.purpose: Section headings, sidebar wordmark, modal titles.

stat.purpose: Hero metric on StatCard. Tabular numerics baked in.

label.purpose: UI labels, nav rows, buttons, body text. The workhorse.

eyebrow.purpose: Uppercase tags above headings and stat-card category labels.

meta.purpose: Captions, helper text under inputs, secondary metadata.

mono.purpose: Pairing codes, screen IDs, file paths. Geist Mono.

shadows.name: inset-top-edge
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift on every surface card.

shadows.name: stat-lift
shadows.purpose: StatCard elevation; deeper drop so the metric reads as primary.

shadows.name: drawer-cast
shadows.purpose: Mobile nav drawer casting onto the dimmed body.

shadows.name: primary-cta-halo
shadows.purpose: Inset top-edge highlight plus a warm gold drop behind primary buttons. Earned, not decorative.

shadows.name: sidebar-seam
shadows.purpose: Single-pixel highlight along the inner edge of the desktop sidebar.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for fades and reveals. Exponential, no bounce.

motion.name: duration-shell
motion.purpose: Sidebar collapse width transition (the one layout-prop exception).

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile → desktop shell switchover. Below md: top bar + drawer. At/above md: persistent sidebar.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary CTA on a screen. Gold background, deep-indigo text, earned halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.81 0.155 75); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 290); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.002em; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.25) inset, 0 8px 20px -10px oklch(0.81 0.155 75 / 0.6); transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.74 0.165 70); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.15 0.022 290), 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral non-primary action. Surface-2 with a thin border. No halo.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.24 0.034 290); color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.14); border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.20 0.028 290); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.15 0.022 290), 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirm. Saturated coral with on-danger deep-warm text.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: oklch(0.74 0.135 25); color: oklch(0.20 0.04 25); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: oklch(0.74 0.135 25 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.15 0.022 290), 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Surface-2 input with strong border, gold focus ring, accessible error linkage.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); } .ds-input { background: oklch(0.24 0.034 290); color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80); border: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.14); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.35; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.985 0.004 80 / 0.46); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.81 0.155 75); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface-1 panel with ghost-thin border, inset-top-edge highlight, soft drop.
components.html:
Screen status

narrative.overview:
Yugo's admin is a console for one technical operator running five Smart TVs. The interface is a dark indigo workshop with a single gold filament for the next action. It should feel like a tool the operator earned, not a product being sold to them. Calm, low-affect, expert-confident. Closer to a piece of broadcast hardware than a SaaS dashboard.

Density is earned through hierarchy, not stuffing. Surfaces tint, never gloss. Color carries meaning (status, navigation, danger) and gold is reserved as punctuation for the primary path. The interface does its job and steps out of the way.

This system explicitly rejects, as named in PRODUCT.md: generic SaaS gradient dashboards (2022–2025), Linear/Vercel visual cosplay, consumer-warm cream tones (Notion-light, Stripe-marketing), crypto and AI terminal aesthetics (neon-on-black, brutalist grids, scanlines), and corporate BI tools (circular brand-color icons, gratuitous charts).
keyCharacteristics: Dark indigo foundation (hue ~290°) with off-axis violet wash on the body.
Three semantic accents: gold (action), mint (online/success), violet (info, current nav), coral (danger).
OKLCH throughout. No pure #000 or #fff anywhere.
Layered surfaces, not glass. Backdrop blur is reserved for sticky bars.
One sans family (Geist) carries every text role. Mono is reserved for codes and IDs.
Mobile is a first-class surface, designed for thumb-reach in front of a TV.

rules.name: The Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Yugo Gold is punctuation, never decoration. It marks the next action, the focused field, or the brand moment. If gold appears on more than ~10% of a screen, the hierarchy has collapsed and the screen is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Pixel Rule
rules.body: No #000, no #fff. Every neutral carries a tiny brand chroma so the system never reads as flat. The closest you go to black is oklch(0.15 0.022 290); the closest to white is oklch(0.985 0.004 80).

rules.name: The Meaning-Bearing-Color Rule
rules.body: Color names a state: online (mint), current nav (violet), action (gold), danger (coral), caution (amber). Color never decorates. If a colored element doesn't carry one of these meanings, it's the wrong color.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: A single Geist family covers the whole UI. No display serif, no condensed accents, no second sans. If a design needs a fancy heading, the answer is weight + scale, not a new family.

rules.name: The Tnum Rule
rules.body: Any column of digits (counts, sizes, durations, IDs, pairing codes) uses tabular numerics. Numbers must not shift width as they update.

rules.name: The Token-Or-Don't Rule
rules.body: Use text-display / text-h1 / text-h2 / text-stat / text-label / text-eyebrow / text-meta in markup. Stacking text-sm font-medium tracking-tight inline is forbidden; it is how scales drift.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a lighter surface before a heavier shadow. A card lifts because surface-1 is lighter than the body, not because it has a big drop shadow. Shadows reinforce, they don't carry the elevation alone.

rules.name: The Earned-Halo Rule
rules.body: The gold halo behind primary buttons is reserved for the single primary action on a screen. Two halos on the same screen mean one of them isn't actually primary.

dos: Do lead with the type-scale utility classes (text-display, text-h1, text-h2, text-stat, text-label, text-eyebrow, text-meta). They bake size, leading, tracking, and weight together.
Do use semantic color tokens (bg-accent, text-info, bg-danger-soft), never the raw --yugo-* brand colors in components. The raw tokens are migration-only.
Do carry status with shape, icon, or label alongside color. Color is never the sole carrier of state.
Do layer elevation tonally first (surface-1 → surface-2 → surface-3) before reaching for a shadow.
Do use OKLCH for every color. Reduce chroma as lightness approaches the extremes.
Do size touch targets to ≥44×44 px on mobile surfaces. The on-site flow is thumb-driven, standing in front of a TV.
Do prefer inline progressive disclosure over modals. Modals are a last resort for irreversible actions.
Do keep gold rare. One primary action per screen. One focused field at a time.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion. Fade transitions only; never parallax or scroll-driven choreography.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS dashboard tropes: purple-to-blue gradients, glass cards by default, the hero-metric template, gradient text, identical-card grids, or modal-first flows.
Don't clone Linear or Vercel surfaces directly. Borrow the discipline (reliable + technical register), not the visual signature.
Don't introduce consumer-warm cream tones: Notion-light, Stripe-marketing cream, beige backgrounds. Yugo lives in dark, full stop.
Don't drift into crypto / AI terminal aesthetics: neon-on-black, monospace everywhere, brutalist grids, scanlines. Reliable, not dystopian.
Don't ape corporate BI tools: circular brand-color icons, gratuitous charts, dense without earning the density.
Don't use #000 or #fff. Every neutral carries the brand chroma.
Don't put a border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on a card, list item, or callout. Side-stripe borders are banned.
Don't apply background-clip: text with a gradient. Gradient text is banned. Use a single solid color for emphasis.
Don't glass by default. Backdrop blur is reserved for sticky bars attached to scrolling content.
Don't put gold on more than one element-cluster per screen. If two things are gold, one of them isn't actually primary.
Don't use em dashes or double-hyphens in UI copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't stack text-sm font-medium tracking-tight inline. Use a type-scale class.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Animate opacity, transform, color, background.
Don't rely on color alone for online/offline, success/danger, or current navigation.
